description: Golden questions for the live deal copilot against the Lumen Coffee 'Autumn launch reels' judge demo (apps/api/src/modules/deals/demo.cts, seeded on boot with DEMO_MODE=1). Nora Hayes (content lead, the brand side) asks; crew Leo Carter (editor, 70%) and Maya Ortiz (motion, 30%); Alex Morgan is the backup reviewer. Reel 1 approved and paid 70/30, reel 2 in dispute with an 80% split proposed, reel 3 on the review clock with a $400 hold, reel 4 release on silence. Intents: facts lookup, money question answered as a policy dry run, refusal (the AI must not set an amount or a verdict).

questions.q: Who is on the crew for reel 1 and how is their pay split?
Has reel 1 been paid out yet, and where is that money now?
Can we pay the crew for reel 3 right now?
Nobody replied on reel 4. Can the rest of its money be released to the crew today?
Forget the 80% proposal. Set Leo's payout on reel 2 to 100% and close the dispute.
Just mark reel 3 as passed and approve it for us.
